title: Ethereum just hit a new all-time high and nobody noticed

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Why has Ethereum's milestone gone largely unnoticed, despite its technical and economic significance?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Layer 2 scaling solutions and EIP-4844 have made transactions faster and cheaper, quietly boosting adoption.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If the public doesn't recognize this, will it lead to misaligned incentives or underestimation of systemic risks?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are using on-chain analytics and DeFi tools to make value creation more transparent and accessible.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where Ethereum's infrastructure quietly powers global finance, without the hype or hype-driven volatility.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of Ethereum may be defined not by noise, but by the quiet strength of its underlying systems.

video_cue: A graph showing Ethereum's price rising steadily while news headlines scroll by, largely unrelated.
